description: This file contains unit tests for Abseil synchronization primitives (Mutex, CondVar, Notification), focusing on their basic functionality, initialization, and destruction behavior, including global and static objects.

classes.name: OnConstruction
classes.description: Helper class to execute a function upon construction, used for testing initialization order.

classes.name: OnDestruction
classes.description: Helper class to execute a function upon destruction, used for testing shutdown behavior.

methods.name: ThreadOne
methods.description: Thread function that acquires a mutex, signals a notification, and waits for a condition variable.

methods.name: ThreadTwo
methods.description: Thread function that waits on a notification, then sets a shared state and signals a condition variable.

methods.name: RunTests
methods.description: Function that launches two threads to test synchronization primitives.

methods.name: TestLocals
methods.description: Runs synchronization tests with local mutex and condition variable.

methods.name: TestConstInitGlobal
methods.description: Tests synchronization primitives with a globally initialized mutex.
